cases.title: Nepal floods · September 2024
cases.summary: Investigate rainfall context and the documented warning timeline around the September 2024 floods. This point is not a measurement of the whole Bagmati basin.
cases.question: What rainfall evidence and official bulletins preceded the September 2024 Nepal floods, and what would a properly validated early-awareness workflow require?

sources.title: DHM situational report on the 27–29 September 2024 precipitation and flooding event
sources.publisher: Government of Nepal · Department of Hydrology and Meteorology

timeline.title: A monsoon bulletin was issued
timeline.detail: DHM's later report records a bulletin on 23 September, updated on 25 September. This is retrospective evidence of an existing official forecast, not a warning produced by Iris.

timeline.title: Special flood forecasting bulletin
timeline.detail: The later DHM report describes a special bulletin on 26 September and identifies several basins at elevated flood risk. Independent issue-time archives are still required for a hindsight-free replay.

timeline.title: The documented event window begins
timeline.detail: DHM describes widespread intense precipitation and flooding during 27–29 September. Rainfall, river response and local exposure are distinct parts of the event.

timeline.title: Post-event report dated 8 October
timeline.detail: The report is dated 8 October and supports historical investigation. This document date does not independently verify when it became publicly available.

cases.title: Cyclone Ditwah · Sri Lanka 2025
cases.summary: Examine rainfall context around Cyclone Ditwah and separate historical observations, archived reports and today's rainfall forecasts. Colombo is one sample point, not the cyclone's footprint.
cases.question: How did rainfall conditions evolve around Cyclone Ditwah, and which verified forecast, river and official-warning information would be needed for earlier awareness?

sources.title: Sri Lanka: Tropical Cyclone Ditwah · Flash Update 1

timeline.title: Reported cyclone landfall
timeline.detail: The UN update reports landfall on 28 November, with rain, flooding and landslides affecting Sri Lanka. This event chronology is documented after the event.

timeline.title: UN situation update published
timeline.detail: The update describes impacts across Sri Lanka. It is post-event evidence, not an archived pre-event forecast or proof of Iris warning lead time.
